issuesEn: It loaded staticFile('textures/cardN.png') while the workbench/template public only has textures/live/, so it failed to render in the workbench
The wall mixed in a near-blank full-page screenshot (projects-empty) and a 2032×88 search-bar strip, which scrolled by as an empty card and a sliver
560px columns at scale 1.2 meant the side columns were half cut off by the frame with heavily skewed text
The wall was enlarged with transform scale(1.2), so slice text was upscaled and soft
Flat #101014 background with solid-color gradient masks; no space or light behind the wall
changesEn: Asset path changed to textures/live/ and the exception note removed from demos/README.md; added PAGE_WATERFALL_WALL_DURATION=150
Only card-level slices card1–10, split 4/3/3 across the columns with no reuse between columns; 12/9/14s differential speeds and reversed middle column unchanged
420px columns with 26px gaps keep the wall centered in frame; 20° tilt and 1000px perspective unchanged
The 1.2 enlargement and 1→1.06 push now use an outer CSS zoom, so slice text rasterizes at display size and is clearly sharper

Dark soft-lit backdrop with a faint indigo glow behind the wall, aerial-perspective darkening at the far top, top/bottom feathering, vignette and grain; slice cards get a hairline, top light edge and two-layer shadow
